reason: The candidate calls modify_pending_order_items with new_item_ids as an empty list, i.e., to simply remove three items from a pending order without replacement. Policy only allows pending-order item modification where 'each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option' — it does not support removing items outright. There is no policy-defined action for partially cancelling/removing specific items from a still-pending multi-item order while keeping others; cancellation under the policy applies to an entire pending order, and modification requires like-for-like replacement items, not deletion. The user's request (cancel three specific items, keep two) does not map to any tool the policy authorizes as specified.
policy_references: For a pending order, each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option.
An order can only be cancelled if its status is 'pending'... the total will be refunded
Exchange or modify order tools can only be called once per order.
